caseBmwNbtSynthetic.description: Synthetic BMW NBT nav/ store, no evidence: made-up rows and coordinates written by make_bmw_nbt_fixture.py with the Trails and Trips table definitions taken (schema only) from one 2017 BMW 540i NBT unit. Three trails (8 positions with a time tick after each; 4 positions with two after the last tick and a repeated position; 1 position then an unknown tag, so Path Decoded reports where it stopped), two trips, and a trails.sqlite.bak decoy the glob admits and the module ignores.
